# Communications Guide
This section covers the radio equipment and communications systems used by ground forces.
New to the system? Start with [textlink="Getting On The Net" link="AU14CommsGettingOnTheNet"] for a step-by-step introduction.
## Guides
- [textlink="Getting On The Net" link="AU14CommsGettingOnTheNet"] - a beginner's walkthrough covering headsets, relay coverage, setting up an AN/PRC, and making your first transmission. - [textlink="AN/PRC-117G Radio" link="AU14CommsANPRC"] - the complete guide to the manpack radio, including nets, relay coverage, the handset, field phone, battery, COMSEC, staked radios, and antenna masts. - [textlink="AN/PRC-117G: Guided Panel" link="AU14CommsANPRCGuided"] - the standard radio interface, including NETS, LOG, SECURITY, and SETTINGS. - [textlink="AN/PRC-117G: Expert Faceplate" link="AU14CommsANPRCExpert"] - advanced radio controls, direct frequencies, search and direction finding, power settings, EMCON, retransmission, and other operator functions. - [textlink="Field Headsets" link="AU14CommsHeadsets"] - issued headsets and earpieces, their available nets, relay coverage, jamming, and tuning. - [textlink="Voice Procedure" link="AU14CommsVoiceProcedure"] - radio message structure, common prowords, and examples for contact reports, fire missions, and casualty evacuation requests. - [textlink="Comms Quick Reference" link="AU14CommsQuickRef"] - commonly needed prefixes, ranges, antenna figures, radio settings, and COMSEC controls in one place. - [textlink="Comms and Sensor Towers" link="CMUGuideTowers"] - repairing, tuning, and powering the colony's communications and sensor towers.
